newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gutbrod says losses exceed half of equity.
newsitem.headline: Gutbrod says losses exceed half of equity.

text.p: German lawnmower maker Gutbrod AG said on Friday that its losses in the shortened business year to July 31 had exceeded half of its equity, but any risk of overborrowing had been cleared by its main shareholder.
In a regulatory news release Gutbrod said it would hold its annual general meeting on February 25, 1997.
Gutbrod shares were suspended from trading by the Duesseldorf stock exchange shortly before the announcement. The company's stock has been suspended twice this year.
Earlier this month, Gutbrod announced a three-for-two capital increase whose subscriptions were due to run until December 27.
